Rajiv — thanks for the clear ask. Quick proposal below (I've attached a draft SOW v2 for wording on invoice flows).

Option A — Time extension (simple)
- 3 additional weeks (same compute profile and concurrency as existing pilot)
- Flat fee: $12,500 (covers reserved GPU time and support)
- Engineering support: includes up to 8 hours of Redwood solution engineering during the extension
- Invoicing: single invoice for the extension amount; pilot terms otherwise unchanged

Option B — Credit bucket (consumption)
- 250k token credit bucket usable over 6 weeks
- Priced at $0.045 per 1k tokens (effective $11,250 for full bucket)
- Engineering support: add-on block of 10 hours at $250/hr (or include 5 hours if you pick the bucket)
- Invoicing: can be invoiced as a single line item labelled "Pilot Credits"; consumption tracked in Console

Hybrid (common)
- 2 week extension + 100k token credit + 6 hours SE support = $8,750

Notes:
- If procurement requires a single invoice we can consolidate charges into one; if they require split billing (pilot + professional services) we can produce two invoices — both are standard.
- Security review: no data retention changes; SOC 2 artifact set remains valid.

Attaching: BrightForge_Pilot_SOW_v2.pdf and redwood_usage_snapshot_20260625.csv for your ops folks. Let me know which option you prefer and I can move to SOW v3 / DocuSign.

Best,
Hiro Tanaka
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
